messages.subject: Project Ember — EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Pleased to confirm we exchanged contracts on Ashby House at 2.10pm today. Completion is fixed for 15 May 2026. The 10% deposit (£2,475,000) has been released to Pendle Voss as stakeholder. We now move to pre-completion: searches, requisitions, executed transfer and rent deposit deed, and the SDLT/registration work post-completion.

Congratulations — a smooth exchange.

James

James Osei
